title: Talent selected for Angi
intro: Prepared by Irvin Thevaranjan through the independent Ex-GH Talent Network. A focused selection of public profiles with experience relevant to Angi opportunities reviewed October 19, 2026. These are potential alignments, with specific points to explore on each card. Reply to Irvin to discuss interest and introductions.

items.note: Major enterprise relationship ownership and partner investment growth are relevant to strategic partner advisory. Explore BI-tool fluency, executive business reviews, account expansion, and AI-assisted analysis.

items.role: Senior Account Partner, Large Pro Partnerships

Marketplace operations, analytics, and automation experience align with partner-strategy problem solving. Explore strategic initiative ownership, financial business cases, executive recommendations, and the role’s individual-contributor scope.
Owned operating metrics and weather-impact analysis across Grubhub markets. Explore partner-facing strategy, business-case development, cross-functional execution, and hands-on analytical methods.

Instructional design and scalable training experience are relevant to enablement programs. Explore consultative-selling fluency, five-plus years of relevant work, live facilitation, AI tools, and measured sales-performance improvement.
